appfunction.description: Execute one complete Ostadix .O source document through the primary o_execute MCP tool on the local configured host. Use this for user-requested Ostadix computations combining supported runtimes. Pass complete source text including its input values, and optionally a lower timeout. Nonempty bindings are unsupported. Ostadix owns parsing, planning and execution. Returns the actual structured MCP result with execution state, result and evidence. Report failures precisely; do not automatically repeat a program that may already have produced effects. Example source: bash^(printf 42)_bash .

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: One complete UTF-8 .O source document including its input values. Do not pass a path, shell wrapper, OIR, HGraph, or Ostadix command line.

parameters.name: bindingsJson
parameters.description: Omit this parameter or pass the empty JSON object {}. Nonempty bindings are unsupported and rejected before execution; include input values in source.

parameters.name: timeoutMs
parameters.description: Optional execution deadline in milliseconds from 1 through 900000, subject to the configured host limit. Default is 120000.

response.description: Structured JSON returned by the primary o_execute tool, including execution state and the actual result, evidence or failure details supplied by the runtime. Report failures precisely and do not automatically repeat execution.
